set.body: Run matched public end-to-end and prepared-topology baselines without tuning. Attribute graph construction, indexing, packing, refinement or APSP, feature extraction, Gram, cross, operator, allocation, and peak-memory costs. Publish the complete league table and ownership profiles, including losses and unsupported rows, before opening optimization claims.
set.title: Establish end-to-end baselines and bottleneck ownership
